Resolve the exact current default-branch commit.
Bind the exact current source tree for local read-only inspection.
Search all issue and pull-request titles and bodies for an existing zero-thread report or regression.

identity_acceptance: Repository metadata full_name is exactly ammkrn/nanoda_lib and is not archived or disabled.
The head response yields one 40-hex commit SHA for the metadata-declared default branch.
The archive request is derived from that exact SHA, retained byte-for-byte and content hashed.
The extracted archive has one top directory named nanoda_lib-<head_sha> and contains Cargo.toml plus src/tc.rs.
Current-source findings cite retained archive paths and line ranges; pinned-revision evidence remains separately identified.
duplicate_completeness: Inspect every returned issue/PR title and body. Follow at most two rel=next pages. If a third next page remains, classify duplicate completeness as bounded unresolved rather than claiming absence.
prohibitions: No POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, GraphQL mutation, issue creation, comment, pull request, branch, push or maintainer contact.
No build, checker, proof, generator or mutation launch.
No request outside the declared sequence or substitution of another repository.
